name: content-type-enforcement
prompt: The POST /session endpoint accepts requests with any Content-Type, but the body is always read from query parameters, and clients keep sending JSON bodies that get ignored. Make the API contract explicit: POST /session must require a Content-Type of application/json. When the header is missing or names any other type, answer 415 Unsupported Media Type with a short plain-text message and do not touch the store. GET requests are unaffected. Missing Content-Type on POST is also a 415 (no sniffing, no defaults).
